user_goal: Implement W2 Phase 02 Evidence Engine and Run Receipt: add versioned deterministic/interpreted evidence, acceptance mapping, deterministic outcomes, JSON and Markdown receipts, raw evidence fixtures, and tests without starting Phase 03.
complexity_reasons: cross-cutting evidence model, persistence projection, deterministic outcome engine, and receipt exports
functional_requirements: Define versioned evidence records and acceptance criterion mappings
Project existing SQLite run data into trustworthy Run Receipts
Validate receipt integrity and deterministic outcomes
Add PASS FAIL and UNPROVEN fixtures and regression tests
nonfunctional_requirements: Model interpretations cannot invent evidence or override deterministic outcomes
constraints: Do not start safety benchmark UI or submission phases
Keep raw evidence traceable to existing run state

semantic_relevance.name: persistence
rules: receipt projection reads persisted SQLite state

semantic_relevance.name: testing
rules: failure and unproven outcomes are executable

acceptance_criteria.statement: Versioned deterministic and interpreted evidence records validate with valid sources
Acceptance mappings reject unknown evidence and missing evidence becomes UNPROVEN
Outcome engine deterministically returns PASS FAIL UNPROVEN ABORTED or ERROR and cannot be overridden
JSON and Markdown Run Receipts are generated and integrity validated from stored run data
PASS FAIL and UNPROVEN receipts have reproducible raw evidence fixtures
